description: Service de visualisation cartographique (WMS) de carte : Etude BRGM relative aux aléas de mouvements de terrain is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by carto2.geo-ide.din.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Mapping related to the result of a long-term study launched in 2021 concerning raw hazards (glt = landslide, cdb = falling blocks, mvt = subsidence/collapse ground movements, cavity). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map visualisation service (WMS): BRGM study on the hazards of field movements" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.3.0, WMS 1.1.1. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
